decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser marking workstation remains a recent, core-adjacent extension of the firm’s laser range and fits its strengths in integrated, application-specific identification solutions.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer supports the firm’s broad coding portfolio for different substrates and should continue to benefit from a growing market and the firm’s ongoing investment.

The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is still strategically consistent with the firm’s traceability direction, though its somewhat more specialized position and possible overlap with other print technologies make it the most at risk among the range.
As a 2024 flagship line highlighted on the home page, the industrial laser marking systems are central to the firm’s direction and therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
The compact laser marking cabin is a newly introduced product that builds directly on the established laser business and should be retained as part of the firm’s expanding workstation offering.
The lubricant printing system for sheet metal is both close to the firm’s technical base and externally validated by an industry award, making discontinuation within a year highly unlikely.
